scope: F32 native paged attention and CacheStorage typing needed for feasible Q27 CPU MTP; focused lower-layer implementation only.
covered: Distinct plain F32 and Q8_0 cache descriptors, copy/assignment, correct extent, unchanged F16 default.
Batch schema and native page16 route admit F32; CPU provider admits it only when native F32 flash is enabled.
F32 Qwen27 attention geometry: 24 query heads / 4 KV heads / depth 256, 2 query rows, independent double-precision softmax oracle at tolerance 1e-6.
Nonzero Q/K, causal and noncausal execution, left windows -1/4/0, tails 1/15/16, scattered physical pages and NaN-poisoned inactive storage.
F32 decode reuses the native plan across page-tail and window changes; existing half/Q8 native tests pass.
Exported F32 native page indices remain Metadata budget allocations with retained owners and retire correctly.
Existing original-role test adapter maps IQ3_S/IQ4_NL/IQ4_XS to their native GGML codec identifiers; full-model validation remains pending.

abi.requirement: Use matching rebuilt headers/libraries. Operation custom descriptors use inline byte copy, so unchanged sizeof is not an ABI proof.

native_validation.stale_closure_diagnosis: The manually reused generic v3 DLL lacked native page/window/causal parameter interpretation. It returned NaNs in both existing half and new F32 paged cases. Replacing that single native TU fixed all 51 cases.

formal_build_cache.conclusion: The standard project build fingerprints and stages the native page interpretation. The stale generic v3 DLL used by the manual validation closure does not prove a product cache invalidation bug.
formal_build_cache.mixed_backend_source_id: Also includes the owning GPU/resource patch tree, CPU patch tree, mixed-manifest tool, and backend-specific transforms; it is not the CPU-only source_id above.
